evidence: Author uploaded metrics_per_holdout(5).csv (180 full precision method evaluations)
Previously uploaded metrics_per_holdout(2).csv (2005 12-EDR real SSUSI primary random protocol)

verification.interpretation: There are four distinct predictions: conditional DDPM, unconditional DDPM, direct OVATION and interpolation; observed-fused OVATION is an identical withheld-region display baseline.

event_equal_mean.units: erg cm^-2 s^-1 for RMSE, MAE, and peak absolute error
event_equal_mean.caveat: Pearson r averages over event means with undefined sectors skipped; interpolation has 11 events with defined r, others 12.

morphology.peak_ratio_warning: Ratios of aggregate mean predicted and measured physical peaks differ from arithmetic means of unstable sector ratios; table uses the former.
morphology.gradient_ratio_warning: Ratios of aggregate mean predicted and measured gradients differ from arithmetic means of unstable sector ratios; table uses the former.

sources_and_covariate_shift.confounder: Lower raw 2006 RMSE cannot be interpreted as cross-year performance improvement because true auroral brightness and cohorts differ.

scientific_limitations: 12 calendar-separated January 2006 acquisitions do not establish 12 independent geomagnetic storms.
2006 EDRs were screened on original OMNI quality and native support before inference; this can shift activity distribution.
Only two real satellite observation years, 2005 and 2006, with one month sampled per year.
Most extreme storm conditions, including Kp>=7, are not established by the 2006 cohort.
Original checkpoint historical training run and exact UNet source lineage remain unresolved; hashes and apparent model compatibility are not proof.
No defensible claim that conditional DDPM beats unconditional DDPM or interpolation on real SSUSI targets.
No final English reviewer response until complete reviewer issue evidence and manuscript consistency checks.

reviewer_comment_status.R2_4: Strict Kp>5 real 2005 measured SSUSI validation available in independent earlier analysis; caveats retained.
reviewer_comment_status.R2_8: Measured F16/SSUSI independent observation year 2006 now tested with original weights; short and possibly autocorrelated April-May1996 nominal training and broader regimes remain limitations.
reviewer_comment_status.R3_1: 2006 and 2005 measured acquisitions are calendar disjoint from nominal 1996 source and from each other; original trained-checkpoint source/run lineage remains unresolved.
